create_device_mover: create a DeviceMover wrapper that moves a PyTorch module and its inputs to a specified device
build_uniform_model_parallel: build a UniformModelParallelStrategy to distribute model layers evenly across multiple devices
build_tensor_parallel: build a TensorParallelStrategy to apply tensor parallelism wrapping to a module using a process group
create_not_distributed: create a NotDistributed strategy that returns modules unchanged without any distribution
distribute_layer: distribute a model layer to a target device using a UniformModelParallelStrategy or TensorParallelStrategy
